senses.gloss: शेव् (cf. √ सेव्) cl. 1. Ā. शेवते, to worship, serve, Dhātup. xiv, 36.
शे॑व mfn. (prob. fr. √ श्वि, and connected with शवस् and शिव) dear, precious, RV.; AV.
शे॑व m. (only L.) the male organ (cf. शेप)
a serpent
a fish
height, elevation
treasure, wealth
N. of Agni
शे॑व n. prosperity, happiness, W.
hail, homage (an exclamation or salutation addressed to the deities), ib.
शे॑वा (आ), f. the form of the Liṅga, L.
सेव n. (either fr. √ सेव् or सिव्) g. पचादि = 1. सेवि, an apple, L.
सेवा f. going or resorting to, visiting, frequenting, Cāṇ.; Subh.
service, attendance on (loc. gen., or comp.; सेवां-√ कृ, with gen., ‘to be in the service of’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
worship, homage, reverence, devotion to (gen. or comp.), ib.
sexual intercourse with (comp.), Hit.; Subh.
addiction to, indulgence in, practice or employment or frequent enjoyment of (comp.), Nir.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
शेव—धि॑ m. (L. also n.) ‘treasure-receptacle’, wealth, treasure, jewel, RV. &c. &c.
treasury, an inexhaustible quantity (of good or evil), Siṃhās.
one of the nine treasures of Kubera, MW.
सेव-धि w.r. for शेव-धि.
शेव—धि—पा॑ mfn. guarding treasure, RV.
शेवस् See सु-शे॑वस्.
शे॑वार m. (prob. for शेव-वार) a treasury, RV. viii, 1, 22.
शे॑वृध or शेवृध॑, mfn. (prob. for शेववृध) ‘increasing felicity’, dear, precious, RV.
शे॑वृध m. a kind of snake (also ˚धक), AV.
शे॑व्य mfn. dear (as a friend), RV.
सेव्य mfn. to be resorted to or frequented or inhabited by (gen.), Hariv.; Pañcat.; Kathās.
to be followed (as a path), Rājat.
to be approached, Cāṇ.
to be waited upon or served or obeyed, a master (as opp. to ‘a servant’), R.; Kālid. &c.
to be honoured, honourable, Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
to be enjoyed carnally, Subh.
to be practised or used or employed, MBh.; R. &c.
to be studied, Cat.
to be kept or hoarded, Hit.
to be taken care of or guarded, W.
सेव्य m. the Aśvattha tree, Ficus Religiosa, L.
Barringtonia Acutangula, L.
a sparrow, L.
an intoxicating drink made from the blossoms of the Bassia Latifolia, L.
सेव्य (अम्), n. the root of Andropogon Muricatus, Suśr.
red sandal-wood, L.
sea-salt, L.
the thick middle part of curds, L.
water, L.
सेव्या (आ), f. the parasitical plant Vandā, L.
Emblic Myrobolam, L.
a kind of wild grain or rice, L.
शेवरक m. N. of an Asura, Kathās.
शे॑वल mfn. (√ 1. शी) slimy (?), AV. i, 11, 4
शे॑वल m. (?) in comp. forming proper names, Pāṇ. v, 3, 84
शे॑वल n. (cf. शैवल) Blyxa Octandra, L.
शेवाल m. n. Blyxa Octandra, Dharmaśarm.
शेवल—दत्त m. N. of a man, Pāṇ. v, 3, 84, Sch.
शेवलेन्द्र-दत्त m. N. of a man, Pāṇ. ib.; Kāś.
शेवलिक m. (an endearing form) for शेवलदत्त, Pāṇ. v, 3, 84.
शेवलिनी f. (cf. शैवलिनी) a river, L.
शेवलिय or शेव˚लिल, m. = शेवलिक, Pāṇ. v, 3, 84.
शेवलिय or शेव˚लिल, m. = शेवलिक, Pāṇ. v, 3, 84.
शेवाल—घोष m. N. of a mountain, Siṃhās.
शेवाल—घोषी (ई), f. spikenard, L.
शेवाली ind. (with √ कृ &c.) g. ऊर्य्-आदि.
सेवक . See 2. सेव्˚ s.v.
1. सेवक mfn. (for 2. See col. 2) dwelling in, inhabiting (comp.), MBh.
practising, using, employing (comp.), Kāv.; Kathās.
revering, worshipping (mostly comp.), Yājñ.; BhP.
सेवक m. a servant, attendant, follower, R.; VarBṛS.; Rājat.
a votary, worshipper, Hariv.; Pañcar.
2. सेवक m. (fr. √ सिव्; for 1. सेवक See col. 1) one that sews, a sewer, L.
a sack, L.
सेवन . See 2. सेव्˚ s.v.
1. सेवन n. (for 2. See col. 2) the act of frequenting or visiting or dwelling in or resorting to (comp.), Kāv.; Pañcat.; BhP.
waiting upon, attendance, service, Mn.; MBh. &c.
honouring, reverence, worship, adoration (also f(आ). ), Kāv.; VarBṛS. &c.
sexual enjoyment, intercourse with (comp.), Mn. xi, 178
devotion or addiction to, fondness for, indulgence in, practise or employment of (gen. or comp.), Mn.; R. &c.
2. सेवन n. (for 1. See col. 1) the act of sewing, darning, stitching, Suśr.; Vop.; ĀpŚr., Sch.
a sack, L.
सेवकालु m. a kind of plant (= निश-भङ्ग; commonly called Dugdhapeyā), L.
सेवकोत्तम m. (and f(आ). ) best of servants, MW.
सेवन—भावना-काव्य n. N. of wk.
सेवनिन् m. a ploughman (?), Hariv. (Nīlak.)
1. सेवनीय mfn. (for 2. See col. 2) to be followed or practised, Bhartṛ.
to be served or waited upon or honoured, Hariv.; BhP.
2. सेवनीय mfn. (for 1. See col. 1) to be sewn or stitched together, MW.
सेवा—काकु f. change of voice in service (i.e. sometimes speaking loudly, sometimes softly, sometimes angrily, sometimes sorrowfully), Vikr.
सेवा—कौमुदी f. N. of wk. on Bhakti.
सेवा—जन m. a servant, attendant, VarBṛS.
सेवा˚ञ्जलि (˚वाञ्ज्˚), m. a servant's reverential salutation with hollowed hands (see अञ्जलि), Bhartṛ.
सेवा—तीर्थ m. N. of an author, Cat.
सेवा—दक्ष mf(आ)n. skilled in service, Mālav.
सेवा—धर्म m. the duties or functions of s˚, Bhartṛ.
सेवा—फल-स्तोत्र n. N. of a hymn by Vallabhācārya
सेवा—फल-स्तोत्र—विवृति f. N. of Comm.
सेवा—फ˚लोक्ति-विवृति f. N. of Comm.
सेवा˚भिरत (˚वाभ्˚), mfn. rejoicing in or fond of s˚, VarBṛS.
सेवा—भृत् mfn. maintaining s˚, serving, honouring (comp.), R.
सेवा˚वलम्ब (˚वाव्˚), mfn. depending on another's s˚, Bhartṛ.
सेवा˚वसर (˚वाव्˚), m. opportunity for worship or adoration, Kum.
सेवा—विचार m. N. of wk. on Bhakti.
सेवा—विलासिनी f. a female servant, Nalac.
सेवा—वृत्ति f. a livelihood gained by service, L.
सेवा—व्यवहार m. the practice of service, MW.
1. सेवि n. the jujube (= बदर), L.
an apple (in this sense prob. fr. Persianseb), L.
2. सेवि in comp. for सेविन्.
सेवि—ता f. service, attendance, MārkP.
सेवित mfn. dwelt in, visited, frequented, followed, served &c. (see √ सेव्)
furnished or endowed with, abounding in (comp.), R.
सेवित n. = 1. सेवि, L.
सेवि—त्व n. seeking, resorting to (comp.), BhP.
honouring, deference towards (comp.), Kām.
the state of one who dwells in or inhabits, MW.
सेविका f. a partic. sweetmeat (a kind of vermicelli made of wheat-flour and boiled in milk and sugar), BhP.
सेवित—मन्मथ mfn. addicted to love or amorous enjoyments, MW.
1. सेवितव्य mfn. (for 2. See below) to be frequented or inhabited, Hariv.
to be followed or practised, TUp.; Mn. &c.
to be tended or taken care of Cāṇ.; Mṛcch.
2. सेवितव्य mfn. (for 1. See above) to be sewn, Nir.
सेवितृ mfn. (only ifc.) one who honours or worships, MBh.
one who follows or pursues, ib.
सेवितृ m. a servant, attendant, Mālav. iv, 12.
सेविन् mfn. (only ifc.) going or resorting to, frequenting, inhabiting, MBh.; R. &c.
attending on, serving, a servant, Kālid.; Kir.; VarBṛS.
honouring, revering, deferential to, Mn.; MBh. &c.
having sexual intercourse with, Subh.
addicted to, fond of, enjoying, practising, employing, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सेव्य—ता f. the state of being liable or worthy to be served or honoured or revered or followed or pursued, Kāv.; Rājat.; Sarvad.
सेव्य—त्व n. the state of being liable or worthy to be served or honoured or revered or followed or pursued, Kāv.; Rājat.; Sarvad.
सेव्य—सेवकौ m. du. master and servant, Hit.
सेव्यमान mfn. being dwelt in or served or used &c.
सेवनी (ई), f. a needle, L.
a seam, L.
a suture or peculiar, seam-like union of parts of the body (seven in number, viz. five of the cranium, one of the tongue, and one of the glans penis), Br.; Suśr.
सेवनी (ई), f. a kind of small jasmine, L.
सेवती f. the Indian white rose, L.
सेवन्तिका-परिणय m. N. of a Nāṭaka or a Kāvya, Cat.
सेवालिन् mfn. (fr. सवाल, see शेव्˚), g. सुवास्त्व्-आदि (Kāś. सेचालिन्).
सेवासी ind. (with √ 1. कृ) g. ऊर्य्-आदि (v.l.)
